comment: Dr.GC is absolutely great, he is very nice and patient. The lectures are amazing too!! He is definitely not a tough grader! Recommend!

Dr. GC has a hard but fair class. His lectures are fast-moving, but he explains the complexity of music theory in a very understandable way. There is either a mini-quiz or test every week and I would say there is around two hours of homework every week.
Dr GC is fabulous. The class is the perfect in-between of not too easy and not too hard. I absolutely loved it and would recommend the class or him to anyone!
He's the reason why I love music

I really enjoyed this class- he teaches the concepts well and always makes sure to show examples. Overall the class is not super hard, mostly just the material at the beginning of the course. Dr GC will give extensions if you need them and understands that we have a lot going on in our lives. Could not have asked for a better music theory professor
Take Dr. GC for your gen ed! You'll learn so much and the class itself is not hard, although hw can get tedious at times. Couldn't have asked for a better music theory prof.

I really liked this class. I would recommend coming in with some music theory knowledge already or it can get easy to fall behind. He tries to make the material as fun as possible and offers plenty of examples for every concept. Great professor!

Dr. GC is one of the best professors at Richmond. Super kind and funny guy, clearly cares about his students. Very clear guidelines and expectations so it's easy to do well on all assignments. He values participation so it def helps to contribute in class. He's young and relatable so he understands how it feels to be a student :)
Best music professor Ive ever had!! Definitely take him and he takes care of his students
